blocks.text: [ Principle 03 ]
Principle 3: Introducing My Best Friend
Greeting
Almost everyone in the world has a best friend.
I would like to introduce my best friend (김현주) to you.
About My Friend’s Personal Background
My best friend (현주) is (39) years old and lives in (서울).
She has a really wonderful family that includes a nice husband, son, and daughter.
Her husband’s name is (이영철), and he works for Cell-Phone Company.
Her son, (대한) is (14), and he is a student at (한국 Middle School).
(소연) is her daughter, and she attends (한국 Elementary School).
Her house and mine are very close, so we can meet each other everyday.
How I Met My Best Friend
We met for the first time ten years ago.
We attended the same school which was located in a beautiful village.
We were in the same class, so we met everyday until we graduated high school.
My Best Friend’s Personality, Talents, and Hobbies
My Best Friend is an Outgoing Person
I am very outgoing, so I like to do many things with other people.
She is like me in many ways, such as she is also very outgoing but is sometimes more shier than I am.
My Best Friend is Talented
(현주) has many talents like cooking all kinds of food and speaking English.
She is good at drawing, too.
I’ve learned a lot from her such as how to make kimchi and sew clothes.
Though I’ve learned many things from her, I (still) have a lot to learn from her.
(현주) always understands my problems, and whenever I need help, she is always there.
I’m proud to call her my best friend.
My Best Friend has Many Hobbies
(현주) likes to go shopping with me.
We often meet and go to the market.
Sometimes we watch movies.
Last winter vacation, our families went to (경주) and had a good time together.
Because of (현주), I know how important it is to have a best friend.
